g.text: Pi supervisor: SHUTDOWN_REQ open collector (Q11), POWEROFF_DONE -> GPIO35, PI_ALIVE -> GPIO19 (J23 to the Pi carrier)

g.desc: Pi supervisor: SHUTDOWN_REQ open collector (Q11), POWEROFF_DONE -> GPIO35, PI_ALIVE -> GPIO19 (J23 to the Pi carrier)

g.text: ESP32 30-pin DevKit (fed at its 3V3 pin), power-module cable J20, switched 3V3 for CAN + AS5600 (Q10, GPIO18 low = on)

g.desc: ESP32 30-pin DevKit (fed at its 3V3 pin), power-module cable J20, switched 3V3 for CAN + AS5600 (Q10, GPIO18 low = on)

g.text: Knob: SimpleFOC Mini off-board on J19 (IN1-3 GPIO25/26/27, EN GPIO13 + 47k pull-down), AS5600 on I2C (4.7k pull-ups), push switch GPIO4

g.desc: Knob: SimpleFOC Mini off-board on J19 (IN1-3 GPIO25/26/27, EN GPIO13 + 47k pull-down), AS5600 on I2C (4.7k pull-ups), push switch GPIO4

g.text: Q10: I_B = (3.29 - 0.75 - 0.2)/1k - 0.75/10k = 2.27 mA, load 17.5 mA -> saturated; default OFF (R20)

g.desc: Q10: I_B = (3.29 - 0.75 - 0.2)/1k - 0.75/10k = 2.27 mA, load 17.5 mA -> saturated; default OFF (R20)

g.text: CAN: SN65HVD230DR Rs = GND (high speed), 500 kbit/s; PSM712 clamps CAN_H/L to -7/+12 V working at J21/J12

g.desc: CAN: SN65HVD230DR Rs = GND (high speed), 500 kbit/s; PSM712 clamps CAN_H/L to -7/+12 V working at J21/J12

g.text: Input stage: V_on = 0.65 x (1 + 47/10) = 3.7 V; f_c = 1/(2 pi x 8.25k x 100n) = 193 Hz; -14 V: D clamps, 0.3 mA

g.desc: Input stage: V_on = 0.65 x (1 + 47/10) = 3.7 V; f_c = 1/(2 pi x 8.25k x 100n) = 193 Hz; -14 V: D clamps, 0.3 mA

g.text: Push switch: f_c = 1/(2 pi x 1k x 100n) = 1.59 kHz; I2C t_r = 0.847 x 4.7k x 50 pF = 0.2 us

g.desc: Push switch: f_c = 1/(2 pi x 1k x 100n) = 1.59 kHz; I2C t_r = 0.847 x 4.7k x 50 pF = 0.2 us

g.text: Q11 SHUTDOWN_REQ: I_B = (2.64 - 0.65)/10k - 0.65/47k = 0.185 mA; sinks 0.33 mA; off in reset (R30)

g.desc: Q11 SHUTDOWN_REQ: I_B = (2.64 - 0.65)/10k - 0.65/47k = 0.185 mA; sinks 0.33 mA; off in reset (R30)

g.text: CAN check (all off): 121 || 120 = 60.2 ohm between J21.1 and J21.2

g.desc: CAN check (all off): 121 || 120 = 60.2 ohm between J21.1 and J21.2

g.text: CAN: SN65HVD230DR + 100n + PSM712 (JLC), no termination (mid-bus): ME221 (J21) + RJ45 pins 1/2 to main + Pi HAT stub (J22)

g.desc: CAN: SN65HVD230DR + 100n + PSM712 (JLC), no termination (mid-bus): ME221 (J21) + RJ45 pins 1/2 to main + Pi HAT stub (J22)

g.text: Car inputs IGN -> GPIO36, ACC -> GPIO39 (inverting NPN stage, threshold 3.7 V, f_c 193 Hz); battery sense GPIO34

g.desc: Car inputs IGN -> GPIO36, ACC -> GPIO39 (inverting NPN stage, threshold 3.7 V, f_c 193 Hz); battery sense GPIO34
